evidence: You can walk the track in either direction, but there is less climbing if you walk from the North Taranaki Visitor Centre to Mangorei Road.
The Pouākai Crossing begins on the Veronica Loop Track, starting at North Egmont.
North Taranaki Visitor Centre is at the end of the road.
Pouākai Hut to Mangorei Road end
This is a one-way track so you need to arrange transport to and from one end.

doubts: The start is the North Taranaki Visitor Centre at North Egmont; there is no road end feature there, so the start ref is T13 (the North Egmont place) and is not certain. The end is the Mangorei Road end, ref F2 (where Mangorei Track meets Mangorei Road). Shape one_way from 'This is a one-way track' and the page's start and end. The page says the walk can be done in either direction; recorded as described (Visitor Centre to Mangorei Road). Time and distance are DOC's summary values. The page's shortcut from the Mangorei Track junction straight to Pouākai Hut when tired is not a separate way (no heading of its own), so it is not recorded. Minarapa Stream is said to have no bridge before Holly Hut, but the text does not say to cross it, so no how is given. Pouākai Trig is ambiguous between the peak entries T14 and T15, so ref is null. The Pouākai Trig side trip is recorded as a side trip, not a way.
